prospective_common_denominator_repair_no: Freeze one common development denominator E_common BEFORE any layer/alpha outcome evaluation. First run the unchanged Stage1 gate on all fixed development indices0..31. For every Stage1-eligible family, construct the frozen source/projection/control material independently at BOTH candidate layers14 and21 using the same pre-outcome rules. A family enters E_common iff it is Stage2-constructible at every candidate layer: projection succeeds, zero-unique is allowed as exact-zero intervention, and whenever ||r_unique||>1e-8 every required matched source-control vector is nonzero and norm-matchable at both layers. E_common is the sorted intersection of the two layer-constructible index sets, frozen once before the causal grid. Require |E_common|>=24/32; otherwise stop INCONCLUSIVE_PLANUNIQUE_COMMON_DENOMINATOR_CONSTRUCTIBILITY with no grid and no confirmation. Every one of the 8 layer×alpha grid points MUST contain exactly E_common, and all medians, positive fractions, MSA2 competence means and selection tie-break statistics use exactly that same indexed denominator. After E_common freeze, any missing/failed family at any grid point is TECHNICAL_INVALID for the development execution; it may not be dropped, replaced, or converted into a layer-specific denominator. Operational ordering is fail-closed and non-circular: first freeze E_stage1 from all32 under unchanged Stage1 rules; then choose every unrelated-plan donor deterministically from E_stage1 using the inherited next-different-family rule, independent of later Stage2/common-denominator membership; then construct both candidate layers and freeze E_common. A donor need only have frozen Stage1 plan/source material, not membership in E_common.
